features.name: Blossoming Thorns
features.description:
Beginning at 3rd level, when you enter your rage, thorns emerge over your body. While raging, your unarmed strikes deal 1d4 + STR piercing damage (instead of normal bludgeoning). When you use the Attack action with an unarmed strike on your turn while raging, you can make one unarmed strike as a bonus action.

Damage increases: 1d6 at 8th level, 1d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Thorned Grasp
features.description: Also at 3rd level, when you use the Attack action to grapple a creature while raging, the target takes 1d4 piercing damage on a successful grapple, and 1d4 piercing damage at the start of each of your turns while you continue to grapple and are raging. Increases to 2d4 at 10th level.

features.name: Nature's Blessing
features.description:
At 6th level, your thorns while raging count as magical. When hit by a melee weapon attack by a creature within 5 ft while raging, that creature takes 1d4 piercing damage (2d4 at 10th level).

Alternatively, as a reaction when hit by a melee weapon within 5 ft while raging, you can attempt to disarm the attacker instead of dealing thorn damage: the attacker makes a STR save (DC 8 + CON mod + prof bonus) or drops the weapon at its feet.

payload.name: Nature's Blessing — Disarm
payload.description: When hit by a melee weapon within 5 ft while raging, instead of dealing thorn damage, force attacker to STR save or drop weapon.

features.name: Toxic Infusion
features.description:
Starting at 10th level, when you enter your rage or as a bonus action while raging, you can infuse your thorns with toxins for 1 minute. While infused, the first creature you hit each turn with an unarmed strike must succeed on a CON save (DC 8 + CON mod + prof bonus) or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

Uses equal to proficiency bonus; regain all on long rest.

payload.name: Toxic Infusion
payload.description: Infuse thorns with toxins for 1 min while raging. First unarmed strike hit each turn: CON save or target poisoned until end of its next turn.

features.name: Thorn Barrage
features.description:
At 14th level, as an action while raging, shoot thorns from your body. Each creature within 10 feet must make a DEX save (DC 8 + CON mod + prof bonus), taking 4d6 piercing on a failure or half on a success.

Uses equal to proficiency bonus; regain all on long rest.

payload.name: Thorn Barrage
payload.description: While raging: each creature within 10 ft makes DEX save or takes 4d6 piercing (half on success).
